surfaces.label: CZML document
surfaces.description: Primary current Cesium output from the Python package.

surfaces.label: CesiumJS viewer HTML
surfaces.description: Generated HTML shell that loads CZML in CesiumJS and exposes scene-view buttons for basic camera control; richer runtime wiring is not compiled yet.

surfaces.label: CesiumJS loader module
surfaces.description: The imported SDJ workbench has this shape, but the Python package does not emit a dedicated Cesium loader module yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Document metadata
schemaFeatures.notes: Scene id, name, description, source, and created timestamp map cleanly into document packet metadata.

schemaFeatures.label: Scene clock from timestamps
schemaFeatures.notes: Current scene timestamps compile into a CZML document clock.

schemaFeatures.label: Entity point position
schemaFeatures.notes: Entities compile to CZML packets with cartographic degree positions.

schemaFeatures.label: Entity orientation
schemaFeatures.notes: Heading, pitch, and roll are preserved only as packet properties, not native Cesium quaternions.

schemaFeatures.label: Sampled path motion
schemaFeatures.notes: Path objects compile into sampled CZML position plus path graphics with basic styling; richer path semantics remain open.

schemaFeatures.label: Track motion
schemaFeatures.notes: Track objects compile into sampled CZML position plus path graphics, matching the imported SDJ track family closely.

schemaFeatures.label: Vector geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Vector objects compile into native CZML polyline packets with explicit start and end positions plus styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Velocity vector geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Velocity vectors reuse the native CZML polyline path and are treated as a dedicated vector family in the scene model.

schemaFeatures.label: Acceleration vector geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Acceleration vectors reuse the native CZML polyline path and are treated as a dedicated vector family in the scene model.

schemaFeatures.label: Line of sight geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Line-of-sight objects compile into native CZML polyline packets with start and end positions plus styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Body axes geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Body axes compile into three CZML polyline packets representing the body frame axes.

schemaFeatures.label: Principal axes geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Principal axes compile into three CZML polyline packets representing the principal frame axes.

schemaFeatures.label: Relative line geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Relative-line objects compile into native CZML polyline packets with start and end positions plus styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Intercept line geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Intercept-line objects compile into native CZML polyline packets with start and end positions plus styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Rectangle geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Rectangle overlays compile into native CZML rectangle packets with Cesium-compatible bounds and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Corridor geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Corridor overlays compile into native CZML corridor packets with positions, width, and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Ellipse geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Ellipse overlays compile into native CZML ellipse packets with semi-major and semi-minor axes plus styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Circle geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Circle overlays compile into CZML ellipse packets with matching axes and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Range ring geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Range ring overlays compile into outlined CZML ellipse packets with radius and outline styling preserved in packet properties.

schemaFeatures.label: Wall geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Wall overlays compile into native CZML wall packets with positions, height arrays, and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Box geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Box overlays compile into native CZML box packets with dimensions and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Cylinder geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Cylinder overlays compile into native CZML cylinder packets with length and radii plus styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Cone geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Cone overlays compile into Cesium's agi_conicSensor packet shape with radius, angles, orientation, and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Conic sensor geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: ConicSensor overlays compile into Cesium's agi_conicSensor packet shape with radius, angles, orientation, and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Custom pattern sensor geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: CustomPatternSensor overlays compile into CZML polygon wedge approximations with pattern metadata preserved in packet properties.

schemaFeatures.label: Frustum geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Frustum overlays compile into Cesium rectangular-sensor packets with frustum metadata preserved in packet properties.

schemaFeatures.label: Rectangular sensor geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Rectangular sensor overlays compile into Cesium's agi_rectangularSensor packet shape with radius, half angles, orientation, and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Sector 2D geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Sector 2D overlays compile into CZML polygon wedge approximations with sector parameters preserved in metadata.

schemaFeatures.label: Bearing fan geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Bearing fan overlays compile into CZML polygon wedge approximations with sector parameters preserved in metadata.

schemaFeatures.label: Fan geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Fan overlays compile into CZML polygon wedge approximations with sector parameters preserved in metadata.

schemaFeatures.label: Sector volume geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Sector volume overlays compile into CZML polygon wedge approximations with sector-volume metadata preserved in packet properties.

schemaFeatures.label: Hemisphere geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Hemisphere overlays compile into CZML ellipsoid packets with hemisphere metadata preserved in packet properties.

schemaFeatures.label: Keyhole geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Keyhole overlays compile into CZML polygon wedge approximations with keyhole metadata preserved in packet properties.

schemaFeatures.label: Frustum geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Frustum overlays compile into approximate CZML box packets with frustum metadata preserved in packet properties.

schemaFeatures.label: Spherical cap geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Spherical cap overlays compile into CZML ellipsoid packets with spherical-cap metadata preserved in packet properties.

schemaFeatures.label: Uncertainty ellipsoid geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Uncertainty ellipsoids compile into native CZML ellipsoid packets with radii and partition metadata preserved in packet properties.

schemaFeatures.label: Covariance ellipse geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Covariance ellipses compile into native CZML ellipse packets with covariance-style radii and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Particle system geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Particle system overlays compile into Cesium particleSystem primitives with emitter, rate, image, size, and color metadata preserved.

schemaFeatures.label: Voxel geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Voxel overlays compile into a CZML box approximation with voxel metadata preserved in packet properties and round-trip back into the typed scene model, but the Python Cesium path does not compile them into a native voxel primitive yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Custom objects
schemaFeatures.notes: Custom objects preserve typed payloads and can dispatch through the Cesium overlay emitter registry, but there is not yet a standardized imported-SDJ custom type map.

schemaFeatures.label: Runtime objects
schemaFeatures.notes: Runtime objects preserve typed payloads in the scene IR and can emit opaque CZML packet properties, but there is not yet a standardized imported-SDJ runtime object map.

schemaFeatures.label: Terrain surface runtime object
schemaFeatures.notes: Terrain surface objects preserve imported renderer/runtime payloads and round-trip through scene JSON/CZML, but the Python Cesium path does not emit a native terrain-surface primitive yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Custom mesh runtime object
schemaFeatures.notes: Custom mesh objects preserve imported renderer/runtime payloads and round-trip through scene JSON/CZML, but the Python Cesium path does not emit a native custom-mesh primitive yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Clipping plane runtime object
schemaFeatures.notes: Clipping plane objects preserve imported attachment payloads and round-trip through scene JSON/CZML, but the Python Cesium path does not emit a native clipping-plane collection yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Clipping polygon runtime object
schemaFeatures.notes: Clipping polygon objects preserve imported attachment payloads and round-trip through scene JSON/CZML, but the Python Cesium path does not emit a native clipping-polygon collection yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Classification volume runtime object
schemaFeatures.notes: Classification volume objects preserve imported attachment payloads and round-trip through scene JSON/CZML, but the Python Cesium path does not emit a native classification-volume primitive yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Custom shader runtime object
schemaFeatures.notes: Custom shader objects preserve imported attachment payloads and round-trip through scene JSON/CZML, but the Python Cesium path does not emit a native Cesium custom shader yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Post-process stage runtime object
schemaFeatures.notes: Post-process stage objects preserve imported attachment payloads and round-trip through scene JSON/CZML, but the Python Cesium path does not emit a native post-process stage yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Polyline volume geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Polyline volumes compile into native CZML polylineVolume packets with positions, shape points, and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Plane geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Plane overlays compile into native CZML plane packets with a normal vector, distance, dimensions, and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Tileset geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Tileset overlays compile into native CZML tileset packets with a URI and styling metadata.

schemaFeatures.label: Ellipsoid geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Ellipsoid overlays compile into native CZML ellipsoid packets with radii and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Sphere geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Sphere overlays compile into CZML ellipsoid packets with equal radii and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Uncertainty ellipsoid geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Uncertainty ellipsoid overlays compile into CZML ellipsoid packets with uncertainty metadata preserved in packet properties.

schemaFeatures.label: Covariance ellipse geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Covariance ellipse overlays compile into CZML ellipse packets with covariance metadata preserved in packet properties.

schemaFeatures.label: Text labels
schemaFeatures.notes: Style labels compile to CZML label graphics.

schemaFeatures.label: Billboard icons
schemaFeatures.notes: Style icon URIs compile to CZML billboard graphics.

schemaFeatures.label: 3D model references
schemaFeatures.notes: Model URIs compile to CZML model graphics.

schemaFeatures.label: RGBA styling
schemaFeatures.notes: Current point, label, polyline, and polygon paths carry RGBA color into CZML.

schemaFeatures.label: Polyline overlays
schemaFeatures.notes: Polyline overlays compile to native CZML polyline packets.

schemaFeatures.label: Polygon overlays
schemaFeatures.notes: Polygon overlays compile to native CZML polygon packets.

schemaFeatures.label: Sensor semantics
schemaFeatures.notes: Sensor entities render as ordinary entities or billboards; no native sensor volume geometry is emitted yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Scene views
schemaFeatures.notes: The package emits a viewer HTML shell with scene-view buttons and target/position camera actions, including range-based focus and basic flight durations, but it does not yet compile the full SDJ camera program surface.

schemaFeatures.label: Camera view objects
schemaFeatures.notes: Camera view objects are rendered as viewer controls with target, position, orientation, range, and duration-based navigation, but not as a full runtime camera-program compiler.

schemaFeatures.label: Analysis records
schemaFeatures.notes: Scene analysis content is preserved on the CZML document packet and surfaced in the Cesium viewer metadata panel.

schemaFeatures.label: Presentation records
schemaFeatures.notes: Scene presentation content is preserved on the CZML document packet and surfaced in the Cesium viewer metadata panel.

notes: Current Cesium support is centered on CZML, sampled path/track motion, and a generated CesiumJS HTML loader shell.
The imported SDJ workbench advertises broader Cesium object families than the current Python package actually emits.

surfaces.label: SIMDIS ASI lines
surfaces.description: Line-oriented output for entity-style platform updates; best for simple message or track export, not full scene semantics.

surfaces.label: SIMDIS GOG overlays

surfaces.label: SIMDIS bundle

notes: The package currently has multiple SIMDIS surfaces: simple ASI-style platform lines, native GOG overlays, and a typed SIMDIS bundle.
GOG is the overlay geometry surface. ASI-style lines are the simple platform update surface. The bundle is the package-owned contract that ties them together.
